stories.title: One chart shows the incredible reversal at American tech companies
stories.simple_summary: American technology companies have reversed direction on something major, though the headline doesn't say what.
stories.why_it_matters: Hard to know without details — wait for clearer reporting.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence: Why firms are struggling to set prices
stories.simple_summary: Companies are having trouble figuring out how much money to charge customers for AI tools and services.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're considering buying AI tools for your business, prices may still change as companies figure out what's fair.

stories.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of a company called Palantir made a lot of money last quarter and warned that AI companies can't be trusted yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it's one CEO's opinion, not actionable advice for running your business.

stories.title: Trump Admin Has the Concept of a Plan for AI Safety Rules (Maybe)
stories.simple_summary: The Trump administration is thinking about rules for AI safety, though details aren't clear yet.
stories.why_it_matters: Government rules could eventually affect how AI tools work, but it's too early to know what that means for you.

stories.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
stories.simple_summary: Amazon's cloud service is now letting a coding tool called Superblocks work inside customer systems in a new way.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical change mostly relevant to software engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
stories.simple_summary: A company that helps millions of people evaluate and improve AI models raised $7.9 million in funding.
stories.why_it_matters: This helps AI companies make better products, but the funding news itself doesn't affect you directly.

stories.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
stories.simple_summary: Social media influencers attended a fancy trip paid for by OpenAI, and people online are criticizing them for it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about public relations and social media drama — nothing that affects your life or business.

stories.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
stories.simple_summary: Apple finally made Siri, its voice assistant, much smarter and more capable than before.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own Apple devices, Siri will be more helpful, but it's not a breakthrough — other AI assistants have had these abilities for a while.

stories.title: Breakingviews - Big Tech’s circular AI trade grows too big to veil
stories.simple_summary: Big technology companies are doing business with each other in ways involving AI that are becoming hard to hide or track.
stories.why_it_matters: This is financial analysis for investors — nothing affecting your day-to-day use of technology.

stories.title: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
stories.simple_summary: Europe now requires companies to tell people when they're talking to an AI and when content is fake video made by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Europe, you'll see clearer labels when using AI chatbots; in other places, rules may follow eventually.

stories.title: Congress’ favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
stories.simple_summary: Members of Congress use ChatGPT a lot to write memos and letters and understand new laws.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is becoming normal for getting work done faster — similar to how your small business might eventually use AI tools.

stories.title: White House finalizes artificial intelligence oversight framework
stories.simple_summary: The White House finalized a framework for how to oversee and manage AI safely.
stories.why_it_matters: Government oversight of AI may eventually affect how tools work, but specific impacts on your business won't be clear for a while.
